legend: Flatland is inhabited by pixels of three colors: red, green and blue. We know that if two pixels of different colors meet in a violent fight, only one of them survives the fight (that is, the total number of pixels decreases by one). Besides, if pixels of colors x and y (x ≠ y) meet in a violent fight, then the pixel that survives the fight immediately changes its color to z (z ≠ x; z ≠ y). Pixels of the same color are friends, so they don't fight.

The King of Flatland knows that his land will be peaceful and prosperous when the pixels are of the same color. For each of the three colors you know the number of pixels of this color that inhabit Flatland. Help the king and determine whether fights can bring peace and prosperity to the country and if it is possible, find the minimum number of fights needed to make the land peaceful and prosperous.
input: The first line contains three space-separated integers a, b and c (0 ≤ a, b, c ≤ 231; a + b + c > 0) — the number of red, green and blue pixels, correspondingly.
output: Print a single number — the minimum number of pixel fights before the country becomes peaceful and prosperous. If making the country peaceful and prosperous is impossible, print -1.
note: In the first test sample the country needs only one fight to achieve peace and prosperity. Besides, it can be any fight whatsoever. For example, let's assume that the green and the blue pixels fight, then the surviving pixel will be red. As a result, after the fight there are two red pixels. There won't be other pixels.
In the second sample the following sequence of fights is possible: red and blue, green and red, red and blue. As a result, after all fights there is one green pixel left.

legend.ai: 平面国由三种颜色的像素组成：红色、绿色和蓝色。我们知道，如果两种不同颜色的像素发生激烈争斗，那么只有其中一个能在争斗中存活（也就是说，像素总数会减少一个）。此外，如果颜色为 x 和 y（x ≠ y）的像素发生激烈争斗，那么存活下来的像素会立即将颜色变为 z（z ≠ x；z ≠ y）。相同颜色的像素是朋友，因此它们不会争斗。
平面国的国王知道，当所有像素的颜色都相同时，他的国家将会和平繁荣。对于三种颜色中的每一种，你都知道平面国中该颜色像素的数量。请帮助国王判断争斗是否能够为国家带来和平与繁荣；如果可以，请求出使国家和平繁荣所需的最少争斗次数。

input.ai: 第一行包含三个用空格分隔的整数 a、b 和 c（0 ≤ a，b，c ≤ 2³¹；a + b + c > 0）——分别表示红色、绿色和蓝色像素的数量。

output.ai: 输出一个数——国家变得和平繁荣之前所需的最少像素争斗次数。如果不可能使国家和平繁荣，则输出 -1。

note.ai: 在第一个样例中，国家只需要进行一次争斗即可实现和平与繁荣。此外，进行哪种争斗都可以。例如，假设绿色像素和蓝色像素发生争斗，那么存活下来的像素将变成红色。争斗结束后，就会有两个红色像素，且不会剩下其他像素。
在第二个样例中，可以进行如下争斗序列：红色与蓝色、绿色与红色、红色与蓝色。所有争斗结束后，将剩下一个绿色像素。
